status: registered before one fixed four-arm development retest
concurrency_scope: Strict registered arm order; at most two isolated histories in each arm, questions serial within history.
baseline: Full visible conversation before question; drop oldest whole turns only if byte/window budget exceeded. Record every truncation.
memoria: Approved observation and valid consolidation retrieval with dependency-bound original passages; requirement-specific bounded evidence coverage; original-quote integrity separate from semantic support. Complete evidence JSON <=8000 characters.
judge: Independent binary LLM with frozen adapted permissive rubric; no arm label or evidence override. Gold used only after answering.
failure_policy: Planned IDs stay in denominator; unknown judge coverage and answer errors are separate. No filtered-accuracy promotion.
accounting: Every formation, consolidation, Reader, support, repair and grading call. Shared ingestion once per visible-history hash. Missing usage stays unknown; retained upper reservation is not an invoice.
resume: Not implemented. Keep checkpoints, isolated databases and append-only calls. New execution is a new charged run.
interpretation_limits: Repeated development sample, not a generalization estimate or full evaluation.
Same backbone and budgets; comparison changes multiple native components, not isolated mechanism attribution.
Gold evidence ID coverage is post-hoc only and does not establish semantic sufficiency.
Personal Claim/View benefit and real continuous-user effects remain unverified.
All earlier paid attempts, raw data, gold and costs remain private and immutable.
Four arms share model/Reader output cap; source_only shares adaptive Reader/support. Character budgets are not equal measured token/call/latency budgets.
Formation is performed only in memoria; separate mutable databases avoid cross-arm contamination.
Approved memory summaries are retrieval/organization hints and never original quote fields; usage/exposure/citation are distinct.
billing_policy: Two consecutive insufficient-balance responses open a global circuit; retain every planned ID as not_run. No automatic top-up or retry.
authorization: User requested substantial Memoria improvements following supplied critique, evaluation on original 36 cases, and GitHub commit/push. This is one capped diagnostic four-arm retest, not a new full-data evaluation.

sampling.method: first two histories; four uniformly sampled questions per category per history; no answer/gold/failure filters

additional_changes: Approved observation/consolidation channels locate original evidence and compact dependency-complete formed memories can enter Reader. No forced memory citations.
Query-only requirement specs and diversified bounded gate pool, at most one supplemental round/two queries; original authority scope retained.
Exact original quotes remain mandatory; supported answer paraphrases and grounded date arithmetic are independently checked.
source_only keeps the same adaptive Reader/support pipeline and evidence budget, but omits formation and formed memory.
rrf_only also removes the entire adaptive gate/supplement/support loop, so its difference is not planner-only attribution.
Full visible history baseline retained; all failures and old attempts stay immutable.
budget_note: One four-arm 36-case development retest; 750 calls/USD3 cap covers all formation, answers, support and independent grading. Same registered IDs/backbone/judge and unchanged full-history baseline. No score-selected retries.
